title: Return notFound, not forbidden, for policy-denied region entry
description:
Spec sync to jmap-chat-spec 63e9d08 (diff 0cd3af0..63e9d08). Oracle: the quoted spec text at 63e9d08.

[scene] Return notFound, not forbidden, for policy-denied region entry
Spec (61f2d14): draft-atwood-jmap-scene-00.md L2132: "The server SHOULD also return `notFound` when the caller has no access to the region under its `accessPolicy` (for example, an `\"invite\"` region whose `invitedUserIds` does not list the caller, or a `\"space\"` region whose Space the caller is not a member of), so that the response does not reveal that the region exists."
Code: crate-jmap-scene-server/src/avatar.rs:362-368
Now: When may_enter_region is false, enter_region returns forbidden("The caller may not enter this region.").
Change: Return not_found() there. Keep forbidden only for ban/eject cooldown and the different-user case. Update tests that assert forbidden for invite or space denial to the new oracle.
notes:
RE-SCOPED to spec 6bcd9d8:
Oracle: jmap-chat-spec 6bcd9d8 (quoted text). Mapped by wf_6712c4f8-c2b.

[scene] SceneAvatar/set create: missing region and policy-denied entry must be invalidProperties naming regionId
Spec (): draft-atwood-jmap-scene-00.md L2172: "The server MUST return `invalidProperties` naming `regionId` when `regionId` does not reference an existing SceneRegion. The server SHOULD return the same error when the caller has no access to the region under its `accessPolicy` (for example, an `"invite"` region whose `invitedUserIds` does not list the caller, or a `"space"` region whose Space the caller is not a member of)"; L2385-2387 (invalidProperties table): "`regionId` does not exist or caller lacks access | ... `properties` names `regionId`", "Region `accessPolicy` is `"invite"` and `invitedUserIds` does not list the user", "Region `accessPolicy` is `"space"` and user is not a member of the bound Space"; forbidden table keeps only ban/cooldown and different-user.
Code: crate-jmap-scene-server/src/avatar.rs:357-361 (missing region -> not_found); crate-jmap-scene-server/src/avatar.rs:362-368 (may_enter_region false -> forbidden); crate-jmap-scene-server/src/backend.rs:385-404 (may_enter_region doc: false is forbidden, covers invite/space AND ban); crate-jmap-scene-server/src/memory.rs:1017-1024 (may_enter_region = invite grant check only); crate-jmap-scene-server/tests/avatar_set.rs:278-289 missing_region_is_not_found; crate-jmap-scene-server/tests/avatar_set.rs:339-358 invite_region_is_forbidden_without_access
Now: Missing region returns notFound. Invite or space denial returns forbidden("The caller may not enter this region.").
Change: Return invalid(&["regionId"], "regionId is not an accessible SceneRegion") for a missing region and for policy denial. Keep forbidden only for ban/cooldown and different-user. may_enter_region's single bool cannot tell these apart (see decisions_needed). Update the backend doc and both tests' oracles to L2172/L2385-2387.
Mark 2026-10-20 DECISION: Scene: policy access via existing may_access_region -> invalidProperties(regionId); narrow may_enter_region to ban/cooldown -> forbidden. Dangling parentId/visualRef on update -> invalidProperties, same as create.
